source: CRON 2026-11-21: 9M 2026 column read from the issuer printed page 4 of 48139_UNILEVER_NIGERIA_PLC.-_QUARTER_3_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_OCTOBER_2026.pdf in the NGX doclib filing library, in thousands of naira stored as absolute naira. Printed and stored: revenue 184,007,260; cost of sales 98,544,540; gross profit 85,462,720; selling and distribution expenses 7,312,930; marketing and administrative expenses 40,302,778; impairment write back 43,070; other income 651,658; operating profit 38,541,740; finance income 9,166,849; finance cost 2,132,760; net finance income 7,034,089; profit before taxation 45,575,829; taxation 19,173,109; profit for the period 26,402,720; earnings per share 4.60 naira. Ties: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit and profit before tax less income tax equals net profit. Net Finance Costs is written negative because the period carries net finance income, the same convention as the stored 2026 half year column. The filing also prints a separate three month column on page 3, which was not used. source_note: H1 2026 column rebuilt 2026-10-06 from the issuer H1 2026 interim report (Unilever Nigeria Plc H1 Interim Financial Report, statement of profit or loss, year to date 30 June 2026, NGX filing library doclib 47500): Revenue 119,923,255,000; Cost of Sales 65,184,675,000; Gross Profit 54,738,580,000; Operating Expenses 31,160,381,000 (selling and distribution 4,771,072 plus marketing and administrative 26,389,309); Operating Profit (EBIT) 24,359,220,000; Net Finance Costs -4,816,567,000 (net finance income); Profit Before Tax 29,175,787,000; Income Tax 13,577,949,000; Net Profit 15,597,838,000; EPS 2.72. UNIT: NGN. Prior H1 2026 cell set was wrong: Cost of Sales had been back-filled as Revenue minus Net Profit and Gross Profit, Operating Profit and Profit Before Tax had all been set to the Net Profit figure. Identities checked: Revenue minus Cost of Sales = Gross Profit; Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax = Net Profit.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2022; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note). Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
periodOrder: repaired 2026-10-04: periods were not newest-first; reordered so periods[0] is the newest period and every value stays on its own period label
